top_reforms.description: Merged six legacy benefits into one; improved work-incentives by smoothing taper rate; reduced welfare trap for low-income earners.
top_reforms.outcome: Employment rate rose to record highs pre-pandemic; marginal effective tax rate on benefits reduced.
top_reforms.source: OECD Economic Survey of the UK 2023; DWP evaluation

top_reforms.reform: Bank of England independence & post-GFC macro-prudential framework (2008–2014)
top_reforms.description: Creation of Financial Policy Committee; stress-testing regime; higher capital buffers prevented second banking collapse.
top_reforms.outcome: Financial sector stabilised after 2008; UK avoided full bank nationalisation beyond RBS/HBOS.
top_reforms.source: OECD Economic Survey of the UK 2010; Bank of England Financial Stability Reports

top_reforms.reform: North Sea oil fiscal regime reform & Hinkley / energy diversification (2012–2024)
top_reforms.description: Reform of petroleum revenue tax; commitment to renewable energy targets under CfD auctions; offshore wind scale-up.
top_reforms.outcome: UK became global leader in offshore wind; energy security improved; green industrial strategy emerged.
top_reforms.source: OECD Economic Survey of the UK 2022
